scripts.start: node outils/ecrire-configuration.mjs && node outils/generer-index-contenu.mjs && ng serve
scripts.build: node outils/ecrire-configuration.mjs && node outils/generer-index-contenu.mjs && ng build && node outils/finaliser-build.mjs
scripts.watch: node outils/ecrire-configuration.mjs && node outils/generer-index-contenu.mjs && ng build --watch --configuration development
scripts.test: node outils/ecrire-configuration.mjs --tests && node outils/generer-index-contenu.mjs && npm run test:outils && ng test
